register_gap: The onboarding gives each screen one thought in at most three registers (a 13pt tracked eyebrow, a 44-56pt serif statement with one italic punch word, a 15-17pt whisper) and holds 50-80% of the panel as bare cream composed around the statement; beats 05, 10 and 19 contain nothing above whisper size except the statement itself. The app compresses the same materials into six or seven simultaneous registers in the top 60% of the screen: p5_functional_home stacks three tracked-caps lines before its headline, amputates its own letter to "this is day 12, n…", and sets its hero numeral at half scale (860 at ~38pt against the demo's 500 at ~78pt), so its large lower emptiness reads as leftover, not placed. Grammars the onboarding never speaks return everywhere: seven chevroned index rows on p2_becoming, seven outline pills plus an empty radio circle on p4_home_evening_list, a dismissible banner with CTA, iMessage bubbles and a white chart card on chat_final. Same cloth, different tailoring: the onboarding is cut like a kimono, nothing extra; the app is cut like a cargo vest.
onboarding_dna: One thought per screen: a single JeniHeroSerif statement at 44-56pt, two lines maximum, one italic punch word; in beats 05, 10 and 19 nothing else on the panel rises above whisper size.

Placed emptiness at 50-80%: beat 05 floats its statement at ~45% screen height with cream above and below; beat 10 leaves the middle ~55% untouched between sub-line and pill. Emptiness surrounds the thought; it is never residue at the bottom.
Three type registers maximum: one 13pt tracked-caps eyebrow at ~40% opacity (HER ARRIVAL, HER FOOD STORY), one display serif, one 15-17pt whisper. No beat shows two caps lines on one screen.
Zero containers: no cards, no borders except selection controls; structure is full-width hairlines at ~8% cocoa, and the act receipt (beats 19/21) is a label-left / value-right ledger on open cream.
Numerals as imagery: beat 13 sets 500 at ~78pt didone with a 26pt italic unit beside it and ±75 whispered beneath; numbers get display scale and a serif voice, never body scale.
One action: a single 64pt cocoa pill, or no chrome at all (tap to continue as 15pt ghost text). Never two competing actions, never an inline CTA.
Photography is full-bleed: beat 13's plate owns the top ~48% edge to edge under the status bar, never inset, never rounded into a card.
Selection rows breathe: 44pt thin-stroke circles at ~100-130pt row pitch with hairline separations (beats 03/08); the generosity, not the circle, is what reads as luxury.

screen_directions.direction: Merge the three tracked-caps lines into one 13pt whisper (monday, july 27 · day 12 · finding steady); one quiet mark top-right replaces camera disc plus hamburger. The statement snap the next plate rises to 52-56pt at optical center, ~40% height, cream above and below. The truncated letter row dies; a small unbroken jeni-mark seal by the masthead opens the letter whole. Below the statement one object grows: 860 promoted to 72-80pt didone, with of ~1,473 as 15pt whisper and room for ~600 italic beneath, the day's number becoming the imagery exactly as beat 13's 500 was. Protein, steps and cycle collapse into a three-line receipt ledger, label left, value right, hairline separated, no chevrons, no banner. What the screen becomes: a morning altar; one sentence, one number, one ledger, air.

The uniform seven-row index dies. One signal hangs as the lead story with full display treatment: 13pt eyebrow, 40-52pt serif verdict, one 64pt-plus didone numeral or full-bleed figure, printed on pageIvory #F8F0EC cover stock so the room visibly changes paper from Home's cream. The remaining signals demote to a quiet contents ledger in receipt grammar: caps whisper left, serif verdict right, hairlines, no chevrons, no tap-to-open. The masthead becoming grows toward 56pt italic with the week line as its only companion. Inside the story pages every fact prints once: percentages sit on their bars (folio_v6 currently prints MORNING/AFTERNOON/EVENING twice and exiles the numbers 66pt below their shapes), counsel speaks in one voice not two, and the weight chart's y-range crops to the data so the line inhabits its field instead of floating on ~160pt of empty gradient (folio_scrollpager). The ribbon replaces i · of xii. What the screen becomes: a gallery, one work per wall.

Nearly correct already; compose it like beat 19. The letter drops to optical center so cream surrounds it above and below instead of pooling underneath; JENI, hairline, monday stays as the only header. One action remains: the reply pill alone. keep it ♥ becomes the seal: pressing it inscribes the jeni mark at the letter's sign-off with the same kept-line ceremony, so keeping the letter and keeping a promise become one gesture. Nothing else enters the room.

Every bubble and the white trend card die. jeni's turns are set type on bare cream, 17pt DMSans paragraphs in exactly the letter's voice, separated by the italic date divider the screen already owns (today between hairlines); her numbers appear as inline didone lines (163.6 lb at ~28pt), never carded. The user's words sit right-aligned in rose italic serif, unboxed, like a note pencilled in a margin. One chrome layer at the foot: the input collapses to a single hairline with talk to jeni… ghost text that grows into a field on focus, and the tab bar yields while composing. What the screen becomes: correspondence read aloud in a salon, not an iMessage imitation.

Beat 13 is the founder-signed standard; hold the live result to it exactly. Photograph full-bleed owning the top ~48%, never inset, never carded; cream panel beneath with the dish name as 17pt whisper; the calorie numeral at ~78pt didone with italic unit and ±range whispered under; the three-line ingredient ledger name-left number-right on hairlines; one italic verdict line; one cocoa pill. Everything the demo does not show (chips, steppers, share chrome) waits behind the fold or the next slide. When the plate is kept, the jeni mark lands beside the dish name with the same 320ms inscription, so the still life is signed like everything else in the house.

checklist_signature.at_rest: No circle, no box, no leading glyph. An unkept item is a line of the day's letter: 24pt JeniHeroSerif, flush left on bare cream, cocoa ink at 55% opacity, its consequence whispered beneath in 15pt DMSans textSecondary; entries sit at ~88pt pitch separated by 8%-cocoa hairlines. The left margin stays empty; the line reads as an unfinished sentence, not a task. (This deletes the ~40pt radio circle visible before snap a meal on p4_home_evening_list.)
checklist_signature.completion: Press and hold, ~450ms; ceremony needs duration, a tap is a transaction. Under the hold the ink settles: opacity rises 55 to 100% and the line's punch word turns italic. On release the jeni mark ✦ inscribes itself after the final word like a seal closing a sentence: drawn stroke-wise over 320ms with a 45-degree settle, 14pt, jeweledRose #7A2E3F, while a hairline of accentSubtle sweeps once beneath the line, left to right, 240ms, and fades. Haptic is a soft swell through the hold and one crisp detent as the mark lands. Beneath, a whisper: kept · 9:41pm. No checkmark, no strike-through, no green; the state word is kept, never done.
checklist_signature.day_complete: When the last line takes its mark the day closes like a letter: the hairlines between entries fade, the kept lines settle 8pt closer together, each seal glints once in sequence left to right at 120ms intervals, and a single full-width hairline draws beneath the block with the day set at right in italic serif, monday, kept ♥, in jeweledRose. One warm haptic swell, then stillness. The closed block is the day's receipt, the same object the becoming ledger later prints. No confetti, no burst; an inkstone ceremony that leaves the emptiness intact.
checklist_signature.why_inevitable: The ✦ already signs the brand on the tab bar, and the whole house speaks in correspondence: jeni writes, she keeps. A coach who writes letters seals promises rather than ticking boxes, so ink settling plus a seal at the sentence's end is the only completion grammar that belongs to this object. Todoist cannot own it, Apple cannot own it, and it is built from nothing but the three faces, cocoa ink, one rose, and the house glyph: it could be no other way.

becoming_pagination.description: A bookmark ribbon replaces counting. One 1pt thread of accentSubtle runs the content width at the page foot; your place is a 24pt segment of jeweledRose lying on it. A swipe drags the segment along the thread with spring tension, stretching ~4pt mid-gesture and settling with a soft detent, so position is felt the way remaining pages are felt at a magazine's edge: as length of thread left under the thumb, not as a number. No numerals, no counted dots; the page's eyebrow (WEIGHT, PROTEIN TIMING) already names where you are. At rest the ribbon sleeps at 30% opacity and wakes only while the pager moves, replacing the mechanical i · of xii front-matter folio with something the hand understands before the eye reads.

deletions: p5_functional_home: the truncated letter preview row (FROM JENI back after 10 days. this is day 12, n…). A letter is never amputated mid-word; it appears whole, as the evening screen proves it fits, or as a sealed jeni mark that opens the letter moment.

p5_functional_home: the cycle banner (hungrier weeks have a rhythm… connect ×). Banner plus outline CTA plus dismiss cross is productivity grammar; if the sentence is earned it becomes one whisper line in the ledger.

p5_functional_home: one of the twin tracked-caps header lines. MONDAY, JULY 27 and DAY 12 · WEEK 2 OF 20 · FINDING STEADY merge into a single 13pt whisper; the hamburger and the camera disc reduce to one quiet mark.
p4_home_evening_list: the empty radio circle before snap a meal, replaced by the kept line; no leading glyph ever again anywhere in the house.

p4_home_evening_list: the four tonight's-plan outline pills. The plan becomes one italic serif line (tonight: tea first, then an early night.); seven outlined pills on one screen is a control panel, not a page.
p2_becoming: all seven chevrons in HER SIGNALS plus the tap-to-open caption. The row itself is the door; corridor signage breaks the gallery.

folio_v6: the duplicate caption row (14% MORNING · 28% AFTERNOON · 58% EVENING) and the twice-printed advice sentence. Each fact prints once: percentages live on their bars, counsel speaks in one voice.

chat_final: the white trend card and every message bubble. jeni's words go directly onto cream as the letter moment proves they can; numbers become inline didone lines; the user's words sit in rose italic, right-aligned, unboxed.
one_transformative_move: One thought per screen at display scale, everything else demoted to whisper or removed. Apply the onboarding's own law to the app: each surface states its single thought in 44-56pt serif with placed cream around it (Home's statement, then its 76pt numeral; becoming's one lead story; the letter centered; jeni's unboxed sentences; the plate's one number), and every element that is neither the thought nor its whisper ledger leaves. Ma returns in one stroke, because what remains after the deletions is not absence but attention, and the expensive feeling the founder wants is exactly that attention made visible.
